summary: Honor the dedicated candidate pnpm store with an explicit sandbox-only store path instead of copying a redundant project-local CAS into dependency generations.

compatibility.detail: Candidate install policy invalidates prior install receipts; the shared untrusted package store is mounted at a fixed child-only path and is never selected by trusted builds.

manual.detail: No trusted build may reuse the dedicated untrusted candidate package store.

recovery.detail: Immutable dependency generations retain the bwrap-v1 namespace and existing retention policy.
